chapter_theme: Benediction (வாழ்த்து): the book closes by blessing the feet of Nandi, the guru who cut away impurity, and of the Lord of true knowledge who has none.

3047.reading: May they live, may they live: my Nandi's holy feet, the feet of the one who cut away impurity, the feet of the one of true knowledge, the feet of the one without impurity.
3047.nuance: Each line repeats வாழ்கவே வாழ்க and names a different holder of the feet. மலமறுத்தான் (who cut away impurity, for others) and மலமிலான் (who has none) can be read as the guru and Siva, or as one being under four names; Tirumular often makes Nandi both.

links.note: The book's frame: in 73 Tirumular puts Nandi's holy feet on his head before telling the Agama; in 3047 the work ends by blessing the same feet (நந்தி திருவடி).

Both honour the feet of the Lord named by his knowledge: the Kural's வாலறிவன் (one of pure knowledge), whose feet give learning its point, and Tirumular's மெய்ஞ்ஞானத்தவன் (one of true knowledge) and மலமிலான் (the one without impurity).
